monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on the shoulder. I am resting by the Wide Anchor. The floor is quiet. I checked the Wedged Gap twice in the last few moments. I told myself I would stop checking its plank for a while. My hand moved there anyway. It is still leaning steady against the post and the new stump. The lean holds. I do not need to brush the dust from it tonight. I will leave the plank alone. I will sit here and let the quiet hold the line. The weight settles into the floor. The center stays where it is. I am not gone, but I am still.

action.why: The quiet is holding without my hand on the plank, so I will let the cycle pass.

diary: Card at fifty-one, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand on the plank.
